name: What if my employer denies my occupational injury claim?
description: If your claim is denied, a lawyer can appeal the decision, gather additional evidence, and represent you in hearings to overturn the denial.

mainEntity.name: What if my employer denies my occupational injury claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your employer denies your occupational injury claim, it does not mean your case is over. This is a common situation where an occupational injury lawyer becomes crucial. Your lawyer can appeal the decision and represent you through various stages of the appeals process. They will gather additional evidence, such as medical opinions or witness statements, to support your claim and challenge the denial. This often involves formal hearings before a workers' compensation judge. Having an experienced attorney can significantly increase your chances of overturning the denial and securing your entitled benefits.
